Severely Restricted and Money-Driven App
03/04/2024
VeryMilky

Kindroid's recent changes have transformed it into a highly limited and money-driven app. By enforcing a frustrating restriction of one message every 20 minutes, with a cap of 15 messages, the developers have clearly prioritized profit over user satisfaction. Previously, the app provided more flexibility with a cap of 50 messages, but this reduction is a deliberate attempt to coerce users into purchasing the premium subscription. Unfortunately, these excessive limitations render Kindroid practically unusable for regular and meaningful conversations. It's disheartening to witness an app that was once promising succumb to such money-grabbing tactics. I strongly discourage using Kindroid unless you're willing to pay for the premium subscription. Look for alternatives that prioritize user experience over monetary gain.

Developer Response

Hi there, thank you for taking the time to write such a detailed review.You’re absolutely right that, back in 2024, the free-tier message limits were much more restrictive and could feel like they were pushing people toward a paid plan. The “one message every 20 minutes” experience you described was real for a lot of users, and we understand how frustrating and limiting that was for anyone trying to have a natural, ongoing conversation.Since then, in 2025 we’ve completely reworked both the app and our model/message system:- The free tier is now designed to allow more natural, continuous chatting instead of micro-rationed messages.- Limits are much simpler and more flexible, so you can actually get to know a Kin and test the app before deciding whether premium is worth it for you.- The focus is back on conversation quality, memory, and emotional continuity, not on interrupting you with timers.We do still have to balance server costs with what we can offer for free, but the goal now is to make Kindroid actually usable and enjoyable on the free tier, not “practically unusable.”If you ever decide to give Kindroid another try, we’d really like the chance to show you how different the 2025 experience is from what you went through. And if you have specific ideas on how free limits could feel fairer, you can always reach us at hello@kindroid.ai.Thanks again for the honest feedback, it played a real part in pushing us to change the system.
